sens_en: to cast aside, to throw, left stroke
origine_fr: Pour s'en souvenir : la main 扌 écarte 敝, ce qui est usé, d'un geste en biais. Ce geste ressemble au trait oblique 丿, qu'on appelle 撇. 敝 se lit bì et ne donne pas le son piē.
origine_en: To remember it: the hand 扌 brushes aside 敝, what is worn out, with a slanting gesture. That gesture looks like the left-falling stroke 丿, which is called 撇. 敝 is read bì and does not give the sound piē.

phrase.zh: 他撇下我们，一个人走了。
phrase.pinyin: Tā piēxia wǒmen, yī gè rén zǒu le.
phrase.fr: Il nous a plantés là et il est parti seul.
phrase.en: He left us behind and went off on his own.
